title.fr: Oscillations forcées d'un pendule élastique en régime sinusoïdal

sketch:
Observe: SVG mass-spring schematic with driving oscillator at
pulsation Ω and damping h; polyline shows steady-state x(t) with
amplitude A(Ω) = F₀/√((k−mΩ²)² + h²Ω²). Student sweeps Ω via
slider; a resonance curve A(Ω) draws beneath; peak near Ω = ω₀.
Experiment: 3 seeded target amplitudes A*; student picks Ω to match
(two solutions on either side of resonance for A < A_max). Evaluate:
live x(t) hidden; only A(Ω) target height shown; student submits Ω
blind. Wrinkle: sub-resonance (Ω < ω₀) vs. supra (Ω > ω₀).
